out.reading: Heavy rain and mild weather on the first day after sowing, with nothing unusual seen this morning. Birds that eat seed are less active in heavy rain, but seed in fresh ground is most exposed right now, so a scarecrow is cheap insurance. Hares mostly go after young shoots, which are not up yet, so no snares are needed yet.
out.notes: Sowing runs 8 days. Seed is most at risk from birds in the first days after sowing, and hares become the threat once the young corn shows. Keep the scarecrow up. Send children out only if birds gather in numbers, since their days are worth something. Set snares when shoots appear if hares start coming to the field. Heavy rain keeps birds down, so note whether they return once it clears.
